name: Runner Extras - Report Dep MaxIteration
brief: Proves a precompiled dependency report's dataitem MaxIteration bounds its loop, instead of being dropped and read by BC as no-limit (issue #3370).
description: Regression test for BcAppSymbolCache.CollectReportDataItems never reading the MaxIteration property, and DependencyReportMetadata.WriteDataItem never emitting it. The dependency 'RMI Precompiled MaxIteration Dep' (declared below, resolved from the committed .alpackages/*.app symbol package, loaded from the committed .deps-bin/*.dll) ships report 65801 as PURE COMPILED CODE with two Integer dataitems: one bounded ONLY by MaxIteration = 1, and one bounded ONLY by a where(Number = filter(1 .. 3)) view. The report's own metadata is therefore reconstructed from SymbolReference.json rather than emit-captured, which is the surface under test. BC's DataItemIterator bounds a dataitem loop with `if (MaxIteration != 0 && maxIteration == MaxIteration) break;`, so a dropped MaxIteration reads as no limit and the first dataitem iterates the whole Integer virtual-table window (-1000..100000, 101,001 rows) instead of once. This hermetically reproduces the class of hang that cost 42% of the Microsoft test surface in issue #3370, without depending on an externally-provisioned Base Application report.
